shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure rendered on a monolithic upright block
arms carved in low relief running down the sides of the body
hands/fingers converging toward the front of the abdomen
horizontal belt or band across the waist
pendant/loop element hanging below the belt on the centre line
bands of repeated geometric ornament (zigzag/chevron or striations)
disc or rounded boss motif on the torso (A) / rounded bucrania-like elements at top (B)
justification: Both surfaces depict a schematic anthropomorphic body in shallow relief on an upright block, with the very specific shared scheme of slender arms descending the flanks, hands with fingers meeting at the abdomen just above a horizontal belt, and a pendant element hanging on the centre line below the belt, plus bands of repeated geometric ornament. The chief difference is B's populated menagerie of profile birds, a descending snake and animal heads across the upper zone, which has no counterpart in A, where the torso instead carries a large disc and a sculpted head with facial features.
